answer: Because the sable cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the dune ledger, the lotus audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 10 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Slashing removes 84 percent at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
